subject.title: [Bug]: Install bug:No matching version found for node-domexception@1.0.28

question: Which dependency-resolution strategy should own the node-domexception install fix before this issue closes?
rationale: The remaining fix changes root dependency resolution and fetched package code, and the current linked PR’s target has a known build-compatibility blocker.

options.title: Maintainer-owned dependency fix
options.body: A dependency owner chooses the resolver target, regenerates all package artifacts, updates guard tests, and lands with install/build proof plus dependency approval.

options.title: Repair the linked PR
options.body: Ask the contributor on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95960 to change the dependency target, resolve conflicts, align artifacts, and wait for maintainer/security approval.

options.title: Wait for fresh live repro
options.body: Keep this issue open with no new fix lane until someone reruns the current-main source install path and confirms the exact registry failure mode.

recommendation.title: Maintainer-owned dependency fix
recommendation.body: A dependency owner chooses the resolver target, regenerates all package artifacts, updates guard tests, and lands with install/build proof plus dependency approval.
